message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I couldn’t help but feel a little smug. I’d been prepping for moments like this with flashlights, lanterns, and a power bank that I swore I’d never need. But when the lights went out, there I was, cozy in my living room with a lantern glowing and my phone fully charged. It’s funny how those little things can turn a potential hassle into a chance to relax with the family. It’s good to be ready for whatever life throws our way, isn’t it?
